Key.Original: Send to the target: play from A to B, then jump back to A, forever (with a very short fade at the seam).\nPlay, Stop or Fade out ends the loop.
Key.English: Send to the target: play from A to B, then jump back to A, forever (with a very short fade at the seam).\nPlay, Stop or Fade out ends the loop.
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：从 A 点播到 B 点后跳回 A 点，一直循环（接缝处有很短的淡出淡入）。\n点「播放」「停止」或「淡出停止」都会结束循环。
曲库 %1 首 · 当前显示 %2 首 · 已收藏 %3 首

Key.Original: Deletes the group selected in the group filter above. Its tracks become ungrouped.
Key.English: Deletes the group selected in the group filter above. Its tracks become ungrouped.
Key.Chinesesimp: 删除上方「分组」筛选框中选中的分组，组内曲目移到「未分组」

Key.Original: Send to the target: keep the track, fade the volume to the target volume over the fade time
Key.English: Send to the target: keep the track, fade the volume to the target volume over the fade time
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：不换歌，在「淡变时长」内把音量调到「目标音量」

Key.Original: Send to the target: volume to 0 -> play -> fade to the target volume over the fade time
Key.English: Send to the target: volume to 0 -> play -> fade to the target volume over the fade time
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：音量归零 → 播放 → 在「淡变时长」内淡入到「目标音量」

Key.Original: Send to the target: fade to 0 over the fade time, then stop and restore the volume
Key.English: Send to the target: fade to 0 over the fade time, then stop and restore the volume
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：在「淡变时长」内淡出到 0，然后停止，并把音量复位到「目标音量」

Key.Original: Duration of fade in / fade out / volume fade, in seconds (0 - 600)
Key.English: Duration of fade in / fade out / volume fade, in seconds (0 - 600)
Key.Chinesesimp: 淡入 / 淡出 / 淡变的时长，单位秒（0 - 600）

Key.Original: Favorites tab only. Pick a group here, then click "Delete group" to remove it.
Key.English: Favorites tab only. Pick a group here, then click "Delete group" to remove it.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只在「收藏」页签可用。选中某个分组后可点「删除分组」

Key.Original: Favorited track: changes its group immediately. Not favorited: used when you click "Favorite".
Key.English: Favorited track: changes its group immediately. Not favorited: used when you click "Favorite".
Key.Chinesesimp: 已收藏曲目：选择后立即修改分组；未收藏曲目：点「收藏」时放入该分组

Key.Original: <t color='#ffcc66'>Note:</t> playMusic is affected by each player's own Options → Audio → Music volume; players with music volume 0 hear nothing. Preview is local only.
Key.English: <t color='#ffcc66'>Note:</t> playMusic is affected by each player's own Options → Audio → Music volume; players with music volume 0 hear nothing. Preview is local only.
Key.Chinesesimp: <t color='#ffcc66'>提示：</t>playMusic 受每位玩家「设置 → 音频 → 音乐」音量影响，音乐音量为 0 的玩家听不到。试听只在你本机播放。

Key.Original: When checked, you also hear it even if you are not in the target (for monitoring)
Key.English: When checked, you also hear it even if you are not in the target (for monitoring)
Key.Chinesesimp: 勾选后，即使你不在播放对象里，你自己也会听到（方便监听）

Key.Original: %1: the mod containing this track is not loaded here
Key.English: %1: the mod containing this track is not loaded here
Key.Chinesesimp: %1：当前服务器未加载该曲目所在的模组

Key.Original: Only works while you are a Zeus (curator)
Key.English: Only works while you are a Zeus (curator)

Key.Original: Point B (seconds): the AB loop jumps back to A here. Not needed for normal playback.
Key.English: Point B (seconds): the AB loop jumps back to A here. Not needed for normal playback.
Key.Chinesesimp: B 点（秒）：AB 循环播到这里就跳回 A 点。普通播放不用填。

Key.Original: Type a new group name, then click "Add group".
Key.English: Type a new group name, then click "Add group".
Key.Chinesesimp: 输入新分组名，然后点「添加分组」

Key.Original: [Zeus Music Player] Only a Zeus (curator) can open the music player.
Key.English: [Zeus Music Player] Only a Zeus (curator) can open the music player.
Key.Chinesesimp: [Zeus 音乐播放器] 只有 Zeus（curator）才能打开音乐播放器。

Key.Original: Custom note / alias. Press Enter or "Save note" (adds the track to favorites if needed).
Key.English: Custom note / alias. Press Enter or "Save note" (adds the track to favorites if needed).
Key.Chinesesimp: 曲目备注名，回车或点「保存备注」保存（未收藏的曲目会自动加入收藏）

Key.Original: Send to the target: play the selected track. Music volume is first set to the target volume.
Key.English: Send to the target: play the selected track. Music volume is first set to the target volume.
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：播放选中的曲目。播放前会把对方的音乐音量设为「目标音量」。

Key.Original: Plays only on your machine (local playMusic); nobody else hears it. Double-click a row to preview too. Replaces the music you currently hear.
Key.English: Plays only on your machine (local playMusic); nobody else hears it. Double-click a row to preview too. Replaces the music you currently hear.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只在你本机 playMusic，其他玩家听不到（双击列表也可试听）。会暂时替换你本机正在听的全队音乐。

Key.Original: RemoteExec check OK: %1 Commands mode = %2 (commands allowed)
Key.English: RemoteExec check OK: %1 Commands mode = %2 (commands allowed)
Key.Chinesesimp: 远程执行自检通过：%1 中 Commands mode = %2（允许远程命令）

Key.Original: [WARNING] Playing for all may be blocked by the server! %1 Commands mode = 0 (all remote commands blocked)
Key.English: [WARNING] Playing for all may be blocked by the server! %1 Commands mode = 0 (all remote commands blocked)
Key.Chinesesimp: 【警告】全队播放可能被服务器拦截！%1 中 Commands mode = 0（禁止所有远程命令）

Key.Original: Only configs visible on your machine can be checked (mission description.ext and locally loaded mods).\nServer-only mods and BattlEye remoteexec.txt filters cannot be detected.\nIf nobody hears the music, set Broadcast method back to "ZEN event" in ESC → Options → Addon Options → Zeus Music Player.
Key.English: Only configs visible on your machine can be checked (mission description.ext and locally loaded mods).\nServer-only mods and BattlEye remoteexec.txt filters cannot be detected.\nIf nobody hears the music, set Broadcast method back to "ZEN event" in ESC → Options → Addon Options → Zeus Music Player.
Key.Chinesesimp: 只能检查本机可见的配置：任务 description.ext 与本机加载的模组。\n服务器专用模组里的 CfgRemoteExec、BattlEye remoteexec.txt 过滤无法检测。\n如果全队听不到，把 ESC → 选项 → 插件设置 → Zeus Music Player 的「全队播放方式」改回「ZEN 事件」。

Key.Original: RemoteExec check OK: no CfgRemoteExec defined (allowed by default)
Key.English: RemoteExec check OK: no CfgRemoteExec defined (allowed by default)
Key.Chinesesimp: 远程执行自检通过：未定义 CfgRemoteExec（默认允许），全队播放可用

Key.Original: Warning: playing for all may be blocked
Key.English: Warning: playing for all may be blocked
Key.Chinesesimp: 注意：全队播放可能被服务器拦截

Key.Original: [WARNING] Playing for all may be blocked by the server! %1 is in whitelist mode (mode = 1) and is missing: %2
Key.English: [WARNING] Playing for all may be blocked by the server! %1 is in whitelist mode (mode = 1) and is missing: %2
Key.Chinesesimp: 【警告】全队播放可能被服务器拦截！%1 为白名单模式 (mode = 1)，缺少：%2

Key.Original: RemoteExec check OK: %1 is in whitelist mode and contains playMusic / fadeMusic
Key.English: RemoteExec check OK: %1 is in whitelist mode and contains playMusic / fadeMusic
Key.Chinesesimp: 远程执行自检通过：%1 为白名单模式，已包含 playMusic / fadeMusic

Key.Original: Broadcasting through ZEN events; not affected by the CfgRemoteExec whitelist
Key.English: Broadcasting through ZEN events; not affected by the CfgRemoteExec whitelist
Key.Chinesesimp: 全队播放走 ZEN 事件通道，不受 CfgRemoteExec 白名单限制

Key.Original: Commands are sent to every player through ZEN's zen_common_execute event, the same channel ZEN's own modules use.\nYou can switch to remoteExec in ESC → Options → Addon Options → Zeus Music Player.
Key.English: Commands are sent to every player through ZEN's zen_common_execute event, the same channel ZEN's own modules use.\nYou can switch to remoteExec in ESC → Options → Addon Options → Zeus Music Player.
Key.Chinesesimp: 播放命令通过 ZEN 的 zen_common_execute 事件发给所有玩家，和 ZEN 自己的模块用的是同一条通道。\n可以在 ESC → 选项 → 插件设置 → Zeus Music Player 里切换成 remoteExec 方式。

Key.Original: Search by name / class / musicClass / source mod / group / note. Separate keywords with spaces.
Key.English: Search by name / class / musicClass / source mod / group / note. Separate keywords with spaces.
Key.Chinesesimp: 按名称 / 类名 / musicClass / 来源模组 / 分组 / 备注搜索，空格分隔多个关键字

Key.Original: Select a track in the list first
Key.English: Select a track in the list first
Key.Chinesesimp: 请先在列表中选择一首曲目

Key.Original: Set point A to the current playback position.\nPreview first, then click at the right moment.
Key.English: Set point A to the current playback position.\nPreview first, then click at the right moment.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把当前播放进度填为 A 点。\n先试听，听到合适的位置时点一下。

Key.Original: Set point B to the current playback position.\nPreview first, then click at the right moment.
Key.English: Set point B to the current playback position.\nPreview first, then click at the right moment.
Key.Chinesesimp: 把当前播放进度填为 B 点。\n先试听，听到合适的位置时点一下。

Key.Original: ZEN event (recommended): sent through ZEN, which every player has; not affected by the server's CfgRemoteExec whitelist.\nremoteExec: remoteExec the engine commands playMusic / fadeMusic directly; may be blocked by the server.
Key.English: ZEN event (recommended): sent through ZEN, which every player has; not affected by the server's CfgRemoteExec whitelist.\nremoteExec: remoteExec the engine commands playMusic / fadeMusic directly; may be blocked by the server.
Key.Chinesesimp: ZEN 事件（推荐）：通过所有玩家都装了的 ZEN 发送，不受服务器 CfgRemoteExec 白名单限制。\nremoteExec：直接 remoteExec 引擎命令 playMusic / fadeMusic，可能被服务器拦截。
其他来源（任务脚本 / 其他 Zeus）

Key.Original: Point A / start position (seconds). Normal playback starts here (0 = from the beginning); AB loop loops from here.
Key.English: Point A / start position (seconds). Normal playback starts here (0 = from the beginning); AB loop loops from here.
Key.Chinesesimp: A 点 / 起始位置（秒）。普通播放从这里开始（0 = 从头），AB 循环从这里开始循环。

Key.Original: Fading out for "%2", stopping in %1 s
Key.English: Fading out for "%2", stopping in %1 s

Key.Original: Pick the group to delete in the group filter (Favorites tab) first
Key.English: Pick the group to delete in the group filter (Favorites tab) first
Key.Chinesesimp: 请先在「收藏」页签的分组筛选中选择要删除的分组

Key.Original: Point B must be at least 1 second after A
Key.English: Point B must be at least 1 second after A
Key.Chinesesimp: B 点要比 A 点至少晚 1 秒

Key.Original: Point B is past the end of the track (%1)
Key.English: Point B is past the end of the track (%1)
Key.Chinesesimp: B 点超过了曲目时长（%1）

Key.Original: Nothing is selected in Zeus; select units or squads first
Key.English: Nothing is selected in Zeus; select units or squads first
Key.Chinesesimp: Zeus 界面里没有选中任何单位，先在 Zeus 里选中单位或小队

Key.Original: None of the selected units is a player
Key.English: None of the selected units is a player
Key.Chinesesimp: 选中的单位里没有玩家

Key.Original: Preview or play a track first, then click A / B to record the position
Key.English: Preview or play a track first, then click A / B to record the position
Key.Chinesesimp: 先试听或播放一首歌，再点 A / B 记录当前位置
备注已保存（已自动加入收藏）

Key.Original: Invalid target; click Refresh and pick again
Key.English: Invalid target; click Refresh and pick again
Key.Chinesesimp: 播放对象无效，请点「刷新」后重新选择

Key.Original: Send to the target: stop the music immediately
Key.English: Send to the target: stop the music immediately
Key.Chinesesimp: 发给「播放对象」：立刻停止音乐

Key.Original: Reload the list of players and squads
Key.English: Reload the list of players and squads
Key.Chinesesimp: 重新读取在线玩家和小队列表

Key.Original: Squads of units selected in Zeus
Key.English: Squads of units selected in Zeus
Key.Chinesesimp: Zeus 选中的单位所在小队
选中的 %1 个小队（%2 名玩家）
选中的 %1 个单位（%2 名玩家）

Key.Original: Play / Stop / Fade only go to the players chosen here.\n"Zeus selection" uses the units selected in the Zeus interface at the moment you click.
Key.English: Play / Stop / Fade only go to the players chosen here.\n"Zeus selection" uses the units selected in the Zeus interface at the moment you click.
Key.Chinesesimp: 「播放」「停止」「淡入」「淡出」「淡变」只发给这里选的人。\n选「Zeus 选中的…」时，用的是你在 Zeus 界面里当前选中的单位（点按钮那一刻读取）。

Key.Original: 0 = silent, 1 = full. Each player's own music volume setting still applies on top of this.
Key.English: 0 = silent, 1 = full. Each player's own music volume setting still applies on top of this.
Key.Chinesesimp: 0 = 静音，1 = 原始音量。最终音量还要乘以每位玩家自己的「音乐」音量设置。
